'''FIBUA Operation''',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|270|FIBUA Operation}}</ref> or '''FIBUA ops''', an acronym for '''fighting in built-up areas and inside buildings''', was a military term<ref name="Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] leaders and [[Instructor/Legends|instructors]],<ref name="CSWE" /> to designate any military operation involving [[Ground warfare/Legends|combat]] in [[City/Legends|urban environments]].<ref name="Hard Contact" /> It was essentially a fancy synonym for the term "urban warfare."<ref name="CSWE" /> The first model of [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]], specialized [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor]] designed for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade's]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], was designed for FIBUA Operations.<ref name="Hard Contact" />

==Behind the scenes==
The term FIBUA Operation was first mentioned as FIBUA ops in ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', a [[2004]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Hard Contact" /> The term was later fully identified in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2008]] reference book written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="CSWE" />
